title: Chand suraj jise kehti hai ye duniya zehra
body:
Chand suraj jise kehti hai ye duniya zehra..(2)
asl mein hai ye tere noor ka sadqa zehra
chand suraj...
1. Aaj bhi deti hai awaaz hadis e qudsi..(2)
tum nahi hoti to kuch bhi nahi hota zehra
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Isliye umme abiha tumhe kehte hai nabi..(2)
tumne aaghosh mein hasnain ko pala zehra
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Raziq e kauno makaa'n fatahe khaibar hai magar..(2)
mutthiyo'n mein hai teri rizq ali ka zehra
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Sura e dehr ne ye baat bhi saabit kardi..(2)
tere faaqe se bhi hota hai efaaqa zehra
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Hashr tak kyu na wo araam se aaraam kare..(2)
tere qadmo pe hai islam ka takiya zehra
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Ek peshani e hurr hai to hai ek ashk e azaa..(2)
milgaya dono ko rumaal tumhara zehra
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Ilteja hai ye takallum ki dua dedena..(2)
jab bhi mukhtar se sunna ye qaseeda zehra
author: Muqtar Hussain
